block.minecraft.crimson_slab: A wooden slab is a wooden variant of a slab, crafted from the respective planks.
block.minecraft.crimson_stairs: Wooden stairs are a wooden variant of stairs, crafted from the respective planks.
block.minecraft.crimson_trapdoor: A wooden trapdoor is a variant of the trapdoor that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
item.minecraft.crossbow: A crossbow is a ranged weapon that can load and fire arrows, arrow variants and firework rockets. Holding use will load it and it will remain loaded until it is fired, after which it can be loaded again.
block.minecraft.cut_copper: Cut copper is an oxidizing metal block crafted from blocks of copper. Like other copper blocks, cut copper can be waxed to prevent oxidation.
block.minecraft.cut_copper_slab: A cut copper slab is a cut copper variant of a slab. Unlike other types of slabs, cut copper slabs can oxidize over time.
block.minecraft.cut_copper_stairs: Cut copper stairs are a cut copper variant of stairs. Unlike other types of stairs, cut copper stairs can oxidize over time.
block.minecraft.cut_red_sandstone: Cut red sandstone is a variant of red sandstone, obtained through crafting.
block.minecraft.cut_red_sandstone_slab: A cut red sandstone slab is a cut red sandstone variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.cut_sandstone: Cut sandstone is a variant of sandstone, obtained through crafting and stonecutting.
block.minecraft.cut_sandstone_slab: A cut sandstone slab is a cut sandstone variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.cyan_banner: Banners are tall decorative blocks, featuring a field that is highly customizable using dyes and banner patterns.
block.minecraft.cyan_bed: A bed is a block that can be dyed. It allows a player to sleep and reset their spawn point to within a few blocks of the bed in the Overworld. If the bed is obstructed or removed, the player spawns at the default world spawning location.
block.minecraft.cyan_candle: A candle is a dyable block that emits light when lit with a flint and steel. Up to four of the same color of candle can be placed in one block space, which affects the amount of light produced.
block.minecraft.cyan_carpet: Carpets are thin variants of wool that can be dyed in any of the 16 colors.
block.minecraft.cyan_concrete_powder: Concrete powder is a gravity-affected block that is converted to concrete when touching water. It comes in the sixteen dye colors.
item.minecraft.cyan_dye: Cyan dye is one of the sixteen available dyes.
item.minecraft.cyan_harness: A harness is an item that can be equipped on happy ghasts to make them mountable and rideable. Harnesses can be crafted into 16 dyed variants.
block.minecraft.cyan_stained_glass: Stained glass is a dyed variant of the glass block.
block.minecraft.cyan_stained_glass_pane: A stained glass pane is a dyed version of glass pane. It is a transparent block that can be used as a more efficient alternative to stained glass blocks.
block.minecraft.cyan_terracotta: Stained terracotta is a dyed variant of terracotta obtained by crafting undyed terracotta with dyes. Some of the variants are found in badlands biomes, and all variants can be smelted into glazed terracotta.
item.minecraft.dark_oak_boat: A boat is a drivable vehicle entity used primarily for fast transport of players and passenger mobs over bodies of water. Bamboo rafts look different, but function identically to other boats.
block.minecraft.dark_oak_button: A wooden button is a variant of the button, a non-solid block that produces a temporary redstone signal when pressed. Wooden buttons come in every variation of wood. They are activated either by a player interacting with the button or when hit by an arrow, trident, or wind charge. They remain pressed for longer than a stone button.
block.minecraft.dark_oak_door: A wooden door is a variant of the door made of wood that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
block.minecraft.dark_oak_fence: A wooden fence is the wooden variant of fences, crafted using planks and sticks.
block.minecraft.dark_oak_fence_gate: A fence gate is a block that shares the functions of both the door and the fence.

block.minecraft.dark_prismarine_stairs: Dark prismarine stairs are a dark prismarine variant of stairs.
block.minecraft.daylight_detector: A daylight detector is a block that outputs a redstone signal based on sunlight.

block.minecraft.deepslate_brick_slab: A deepslate brick slab is a deepslate brick variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.deepslate_brick_stairs: Deepslate brick stairs are a deepslate brick variant of stairs.
block.minecraft.deepslate_brick_wall: A deepslate brick wall is a deepslate brick variant of a wall.

item.minecraft.diamond: A diamond is a mineral that can be obtained from diamond ore along with loot chests, vaults, ominous vaults, and suspicious sand. It is required to craft diamond tools, armor, and enchanting tables and is also used to duplicate smithing templates.
item.minecraft.diamond_axe: A diamond axe is a variant of axe that is crafted from diamonds. It can be used to break wood-based blocks faster, but also can act as a melee weapon, with the ability to disable shields.
block.minecraft.diamond_block: A block of diamond is a precious mineral block equivalent to nine diamonds.
item.minecraft.diamond_boots: Diamond boots are a variant of boots crafted from diamonds. They are the second-highest tier of boots, having higher armor points, armor toughness, durability, and enchantability than iron boots.
item.minecraft.diamond_chestplate: A diamond chestplate is a variant of chestplate crafted from diamonds. It is the second-highest tier of chestplate, having higher armor points, armor toughness, and durability than an iron chestplate.
item.minecraft.diamond_helmet: A diamond helmet is a variant of helmet that is crafted from diamonds. It is the second-highest tier of helmet, having higher armor points, armor toughness, and durability than turtle shells.
item.minecraft.diamond_hoe: Diamond hoes are tools used to break plant-based blocks such as hay bales quicker and are also used to till dirt into farmland. They can also quickly break other blocks such as sculk-related blocks.
item.minecraft.diamond_leggings: Diamond leggings are a variant of leggings crafted from diamonds. They are the second-highest tier of leggings, having higher armor points, armor toughness, and durability than iron leggings.
item.minecraft.diamond_pickaxe: A diamond pickaxe is a variant of pickaxe that can be crafted from diamonds. It is stronger than an iron pickaxe but weaker than a netherite pickaxe, and being the  fourth tier of pickaxe it is the first tier able to mine obsidian, a key ingredient in making a Nether portal to access the Nether. It can quickly break various types of stone, ore, and blocks crafted from stone or ore.
item.minecraft.diamond_shovel: A diamond shovel is a variant of shovel that is crafted from diamonds. It is used to quickly break soil blocks such as sand, gravel, and dirt. Shovels can also be used to convert dirt-related blocks into path blocks and to put out campfires.
item.minecraft.diamond_sword: A diamond sword is a variant of sword that is crafted from diamonds. It is the second-highest tier of sword, dealing more damage than an iron sword and having higher durability. It can be upgraded into a netherite sword using a smithing table.
block.minecraft.diorite: Diorite is a block of igneous rock, found in large pockets in the ground.
block.minecraft.diorite_slab: A diorite slab is a diorite variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.diorite_stairs: Diorite stairs are a diorite variant of stairs.
block.minecraft.diorite_wall: A diorite wall is a diorite variant of a wall.
block.minecraft.dispenser: A dispenser is a low-capacity storage block that can fire projectiles, use certain items or tools or place certain blocks, fluids or entities when given a redstone signal. Items that do not have unique dispenser functions are instead ejected into the world.
block.minecraft.dried_ghast: A dried ghast is an immobile, shriveled, harmless ghast that takes form as a block. It can be crafted, found naturally near Nether fossils, or obtained through bartering. Placing it in water will cause it to hydrate over time and become a ghastling.
item.minecraft.dried_kelp: Dried kelp is a food item that can be eaten by the player. It can also be crafted into dried kelp blocks. A player can eat dried kelp  twice as fast as any other food item.
block.minecraft.dried_kelp_block: Dried kelp blocks are storage blocks equivalent to nine dried kelp. They can also be used as fuel.
block.minecraft.dripstone_block: The dripstone block is a rock block that allows pointed dripstone to grow beneath it.
block.minecraft.dropper: A dropper is a low-capacity storage block that can eject its contents into the world or into other containers when given a redstone signal.
item.minecraft.dune_armor_trim_smithing_: Dune armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, sandstone, and diamonds.

item.minecraft.emerald: Emeralds are minerals that are used primarily as the currency for trading with villagers and wandering traders.
block.minecraft.emerald_block: A block of emerald, internally known as an emerald block, is a mineral block equivalent to nine emeralds.
block.minecraft.enchanting_table: An enchanting table is a block used to spend experience and lapis lazuli to enchant items. An enchanting table requires bookshelves placed around it in order to apply powerful enchantments.
item.minecraft.end_crystal: An End crystal is an entity that can be crafted or found on the End's main island, where it heals the ender dragon. It can be placed only on obsidian or bedrock, and it explodes instantly when attacked or damaged in most ways.
block.minecraft.end_rod: An End rod is a decorative light source that emits white particles.
block.minecraft.end_stone_brick_slab: An End stone brick slab is an End stone brick variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.end_stone_brick_stairs: End stone brick stairs are an End stone brick variant of stairs.
block.minecraft.end_stone_brick_wall: An End stone brick wall is an End stone brick variant of a wall.
block.minecraft.end_stone_bricks: End stone bricks are an End stone-based brick.
block.minecraft.ender_chest: Ender chests are a type of chest whose contents are exclusive to each player, and they can be placed and accessed from anywhere in any dimension.
item.minecraft.ender_eye: An eye of ender is a craftable item used to locate strongholds and activate the End portals within them. It is also used to craft an End crystal or an ender chest.
block.minecraft.exposed_copper_bulb: A copper bulb is a light-emitting block. It toggles on or off when it receives a redstone pulse, and does not need continuous power to emit light. Its light level depends on its state of oxidation.
block.minecraft.exposed_cut_copper: Cut copper is an oxidizing metal block crafted from blocks of copper. Like other copper blocks, cut copper can be waxed to prevent oxidation.
item.minecraft.eye_armor_trim_smithing_t: An eye armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, end stone, and diamonds.
item.minecraft.fermented_spider_eye: A fermented spider eye is a brewing ingredient that can be used to corrupt and change certain potions.
item.minecraft.field_masoned_banner_patt: A field masoned banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of bricks.
item.minecraft.fire_charge: A fire charge is an item that can be used as a single-use version of a flint and steel or shot as a small fireball from a dispenser.
item.minecraft.firework_rocket: A firework rocket is an item and entity used for creating decorative explosions, boosting when flying with elytra, and loading into a crossbow as ammunition.
item.minecraft.fishing_rod: A fishing rod is a tool that casts a bobber used to fish in water or to hook and pull mobs, items‌ and some other entities toward the user.
block.minecraft.fletching_table: A fletching table is a fletcher's job site block that can generate naturally in villages. The fletching table is used to turn an unemployed villager into a fletcher.
item.minecraft.flint_and_steel: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs.
item.minecraft.flow_armor_trim_smithing_: Flow armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, a breeze rod, and diamonds.
item.minecraft.flower_banner_pattern: A flower charge banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of a flower.
block.minecraft.flower_pot: A flower pot is a decorative block that can contain flowers, bamboo, saplings, cacti, mushrooms, fungi, and other small plants.
block.minecraft.furnace: A furnace is a block with two functions: it can be used for either smelting or cooking, by placing fuel and an appropriate item inside together.
item.minecraft.furnace_minecart: A minecart with furnace is a furnace inside a minecart. It can be powered with exclusively coal or charcoal to propel it across a rail line for a limited time, which can be used to move other minecarts.
item.minecraft.glass_bottle: A glass bottle is an item that can hold water, potions, honey, or dragon's breath.
block.minecraft.glass_pane: A glass pane is a transparent block that can be used as a more efficient alternative to glass blocks. It can be dyed into stained glass panes.
item.minecraft.glistering_melon_slice: A glistering melon slice is an inedible item used for brewing potions of Healing. It is also one of the many potion ingredients that can be used to make mundane potions.
item.minecraft.glow_item_frame: A glow item frame is an entity‌ or block‌ that keeps itself and the item inside it illuminated, even in the dark.
block.minecraft.glowstone: Glowstone is a light-emitting block found hanging from ceilings and overhangs in the Nether. It can be used as a crafting material, broken into glowstone dust, and is required to fuel respawn anchors.
block.minecraft.gold_block: A block of gold is a precious metal block equivalent to nine gold ingots.
item.minecraft.gold_ingot: A gold ingot is a metal ingot used to craft various items, and also used as currency for bartering with piglins.
item.minecraft.gold_nugget: Gold nuggets are minimum pieces of gold used to craft gold ingots and other various golden items. They can be obtained by smelting golden tools, weapons or armor. One gold nugget is effectively worth one-ninth of a gold ingot.
item.minecraft.golden_apple: A golden apple is a food item that bestows beneficial effects when consumed (Absorption and Regeneration) and is also used to cure a zombie villager under the Weakness effect into a normal villager. It is not possible to turn golden apples into enchanted golden apples.
item.minecraft.golden_axe: A golden axe is a variant of axe that is crafted from gold ingots. Like all axes, it can be used to cut down trees faster, but also as a melee weapon, and it can disable shields.
item.minecraft.golden_boots: Golden boots are a variant of boots crafted from gold ingots. They are the sixth-highest tier of boots, having the same armor points as leather boots but with higher durability and enchantability. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden boots, and do not attack any player wearing them.
item.minecraft.golden_carrot: A golden carrot is a valuable food item and brewing ingredient. It provides the second most saturation in the game, behind suspicious stew crafted with either a dandelion or blue orchid.
item.minecraft.golden_chestplate: A golden chestplate is a variant of chestplate crafted from gold ingots. It is the fifth-highest tier of chestplate, having higher armor points than a copper chestplate. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden chestplates, and do not attack any player wearing one.
item.minecraft.golden_helmet: A golden helmet is a variant of helmet that is crafted from gold ingots. It is the seventh-highest tier of helmet, having higher armor points and durability than a leather cap. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden helmets, and do not attack any player wearing one.
item.minecraft.golden_hoe: Golden hoes are tools used to break plant-based blocks such as hay bales quicker and is also used to till dirt into farmland. It can also quickly break other blocks such as sculk-related blocks.
item.minecraft.golden_leggings: Golden leggings are a variant of leggings crafted from gold ingots. block.minecraft.trapped_chest: A trapped chest is a variant of the chest that functions similarly, but has a red-tinted latch, and produces redstone power while open.
block.minecraft.tripwire_hook: A tripwire hook is a block used to create a tripwire circuit, which requires two hooks and a straight horizontal line of 1-40 string. Both hooks in a valid circuit emit a redstone signal and power their attached blocks while any of the string is being touched by an entity, or if any string is broken without using shears.
block.minecraft.tuff_brick_slab: A tuff brick slab is a tuff brick variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.tuff_brick_stairs: Tuff brick stairs are a tuff brick variant of stairs.
block.minecraft.tuff_brick_wall: A tuff brick wall is a tuff brick variant of a wall.
block.minecraft.tuff_bricks: Tuff bricks are a brick variant of tuff.
block.minecraft.tuff_slab: A tuff slab is a tuff variant of a slab.
block.minecraft.tuff_stairs: Tuff stairs are a tuff variant of stairs.
block.minecraft.tuff_wall: A tuff wall is a tuff variant of a wall.
item.minecraft.turtle_helmet: A turtle shell is a variant of helmet that is crafted from turtle scutes. It is the third-highest tier of helmet, having the same armor points as golden, copper, iron, and chainmail helmets but with higher durability. When worn, it gives the player Water Breathing which lasts for a brief period of time underwater. It can also be used as a brewing ingredient to create potions of the Turtle Master.
item.minecraft.vex_armor_trim_smithing_t: Vex armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, cobblestone, and diamonds.
item.minecraft.ward_armor_trim_smithing_: Ward armor trim is a type of smithing template found in ancient cities used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, cobbled deepslate, and diamonds.
block.minecraft.warped_button: A wooden button is a variant of the button, a non-solid block that produces a temporary redstone signal when pressed. Wooden buttons come in every variation of wood. They are activated either by a player interacting with the button or when hit by an arrow, trident, or wind charge. They remain pressed for longer than a stone button.
block.minecraft.warped_door: A wooden door is a variant of the door made of wood that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
block.minecraft.warped_fence: A wooden fence is the wooden variant of fences, crafted using planks and sticks.
block.minecraft.warped_fence_gate: A fence gate is a block that shares the functions of both the door and the fence.
item.minecraft.warped_fungus_on_a_stick: A warped fungus on a stick is a tool that can be used to control saddled striders.
block.minecraft.warped_hanging_sign: A hanging sign is a variant of a  sign that displays text, and can be placed underneath blocks or with a solid self-supporting bracket. The text of hanging signs can be customized with dyes and glow ink sacs, and they can be waxed to prevent edits.
block.minecraft.warped_hyphae: Wood or hyphae is a block that has the log's "bark" texture on all six sides. It comes in 11 types: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, crimson, warped, and pale oak.
block.minecraft.warped_planks: Planks are common blocks used as building blocks and in crafting recipes. They are usually one of the first things that a player crafts in Survival mode. There are currently twelve variants of planks, which can be differentiated into three categories: Overworld planks made from tree logs, bamboo planks made from blocks of bamboo, and nonflammable Nether planks made from huge fungus stems.
block.minecraft.warped_pressure_plate: A wooden pressure plate is a wooden variant of the pressure plate. It can detect all entities, producing the maximum signal strength of 15. Wooden pressure plates come in all variants of wood.
block.minecraft.warped_sign: A sign is a non-solid block that can display text, and can be placed on the top or side of other blocks. The text of signs can be customized with dyes and glow ink sacs, and they can be waxed to prevent its text from being edited by any player.
block.minecraft.warped_slab: A wooden slab is a wooden variant of a slab, crafted from the respective planks.
block.minecraft.warped_stairs: Wooden stairs are a wooden variant of stairs, crafted from the respective planks.
block.minecraft.warped_trapdoor: A wooden trapdoor is a variant of the trapdoor that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
block.minecraft.waxed_chiseled_copper: Chiseled copper is a variant of copper blocks that generates in trial chambers.
block.minecraft.waxed_copper_bulb: A copper bulb is a light-emitting block. It toggles on or off when it receives a redstone pulse, and does not need continuous power to emit light. Its light level depends on its state of oxidation.
block.minecraft.waxed_copper_door: A copper door is a type of door made of copper that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
block.minecraft.waxed_copper_grate: Copper grates are a variant of copper blocks that have perforations that can be seen through.
block.minecraft.waxed_copper_trapdoor: A copper trapdoor is a type of trapdoor made from copper that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
block.minecraft.waxed_cut_copper: Cut copper is an oxidizing metal block crafted from blocks of copper. Like other copper blocks, cut copper can be waxed to prevent oxidation.
block.minecraft.waxed_cut_copper_slab: A cut copper slab is a cut copper variant of a slab. Unlike other types of slabs, cut copper slabs can oxidize over time.
block.minecraft.waxed_cut_copper_stairs: Cut copper stairs are a cut copper variant of stairs. Unlike other types of stairs, cut copper stairs can oxidize over time.
block.minecraft.waxed_oxidized_copper: A block of copper, internally known as a copper block, is a block that oxidizes over time, gaining a verdigris appearance over four stages. They can be prevented from oxidizing by being waxed with honeycombs. Non-oxidized, non-waxed blocks of copper are storage blocks equivalent to nine copper ingots.
block.minecraft.waxed_weathered_cut_copp: Cut copper stairs are a cut copper variant of stairs. Unlike other types of stairs, cut copper stairs can oxidize over time.
item.minecraft.wayfinder_armor_trim_smit: Wayfinder armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, terracotta, and diamonds.
block.minecraft.weathered_copper_bulb: A copper bulb is a light-emitting block. It toggles on or off when it receives a redstone pulse, and does not need continuous power to emit light. Its light level depends on its state of oxidation.
block.minecraft.weathered_cut_copper: Cut copper is an oxidizing metal block crafted from blocks of copper. Like other copper blocks, cut copper can be waxed to prevent oxidation.
block.minecraft.weathered_cut_copper_sla: A cut copper slab is a cut copper variant of a slab. Unlike other types of slabs, cut copper slabs can oxidize over time.
block.minecraft.weathered_cut_copper_sta: Cut copper stairs are a cut copper variant of stairs. Unlike other types of stairs, cut copper stairs can oxidize over time.
item.minecraft.wheat: Wheat is an item primarily obtained by harvesting fully-grown wheat crops. It is used for crafting as well as to feed certain animals.
block.minecraft.white_banner: Banners are tall decorative blocks, featuring a field that is highly customizable using dyes and banner patterns.
block.minecraft.white_candle: A candle is a dyable block that emits light when lit with a flint and steel. Up to four of the same color of candle can be placed in one block space, which affects the amount of light produced.
block.minecraft.white_concrete_powder: Concrete powder is a gravity-affected block that is converted to concrete when touching water. It comes in the sixteen dye colors.
item.minecraft.white_dye: White dye is one of the sixteen available dyes.
block.minecraft.white_stained_glass: Stained glass is a dyed variant of the glass block.
block.minecraft.white_stained_glass_pane: A stained glass pane is a dyed version of glass pane. It is a transparent block that can be used as a more efficient alternative to stained glass blocks.
block.minecraft.white_terracotta: Stained terracotta is a dyed variant of terracotta obtained by crafting undyed terracotta with dyes. Some of the variants are found in badlands biomes, and all variants can be smelted into glazed terracotta.
item.minecraft.wild_armor_trim_smithing_: Wild armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, mossy cobblestone, and diamonds.
item.minecraft.wind_charge: A wind charge is a consumable ranged weapon that can knock entities back and interact with certain redstone components. It is used by breezes as their main attack and can also be shot by players and dispensers.
item.minecraft.wolf_armor: Wolf armor is an item crafted from armadillo scutes and can be equipped on wolves to provide immunity against most damage types until the armor breaks.
item.minecraft.wooden_axe: A wooden axe is a variant of axe that is crafted from planks. It can be used to cut down trees faster, but also as a melee weapon that can disable shields.
item.minecraft.wooden_hoe: Wooden hoes are tools used to break plant-based blocks such as hay bales quicker and are also used to till dirt and related blocks into farmland. They can also quickly break other blocks such as sculk-related blocks.
item.minecraft.wooden_pickaxe: Wooden pickaxes are tools crafted from sticks and wood planks, and are the lowest tier pickaxe in Minecraft. They are required to mine various stone-type blocks such as cobblestone.
item.minecraft.wooden_shovel: A wooden shovel is a variant of shovel crafted from planks. It can be used to hasten the process of breaking dirt, sand, gravel and other related blocks, as well as to convert dirt blocks into dirt paths.
item.minecraft.wooden_sword: A wooden sword is an early-game weapon made from wood that does more damage than a bare fist. It is the sixth-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a golden sword but having more durability. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, smoker, or blast furnace.
item.minecraft.writable_book: A book and quill is an item used by players to store and edit text. After signing, it turns into a written book with all the text inside saved permanently.
